sentences.en: The factory decided to do away with the old machinery.
sentences.zh: 这家工厂决定淘汰旧机器。

sentences.en: The firm decided to do away with the old machinery.
sentences.zh: 这家公司决定淘汰旧设备。

sentences.en: An old worker was found repairing machinery in the workshop.
sentences.zh: 车间里发现一位老工人在修理机械。

senses.zh: 机器，机械装置；体制，机构；运作方式，途径
